---
title: "New York Weather Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: scroll
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("ny_noaa", package = "p8105.datasets")

weather =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE),
    month_date = lubridate::floor_date(date, "month")
  )

monthly_temp =
  weather |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax)) |>
  group_by(month_date) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

set.seed(6378)

scatter_data =
  weather |>
  filter(!is.na(tmin), !is.na(tmax)) |>
  slice_sample(n = 5000)

station_month_temp =
  weather |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax)) |>
  group_by(id, year, month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    n_days = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_days >= 20)
```

Column
-------------------------------------

### Monthly Average Daily Maximum Temperature {data-height=550}

```{r temperature-line, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(
  data = monthly_temp,
  x = ~month_date,
  y = ~mean_tmax,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "#2878B5"),
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "Month: %{x|%Y-%m}",
    "<br>Mean maximum temperature: %{y:.1f} °C",
    "<extra></extra>"
  )
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Mean daily maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

These monthly averages use all available station-day observations with
recorded maximum temperatures. Station coverage varies over time, so
this chart is descriptive rather than an adjusted climate trend.

Column {data-width=500}
-------------------------------------

### Daily Minimum vs Maximum Temperature (Sample) {data-height=450}

```{r temperature-scatter, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(
  data = scatter_data,
  x = ~tmin,
  y = ~tmax,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  text = ~paste("Station:", id, "<br>Date:", date),
  marker = list(
    color = "#E68613",
    size = 5,
    opacity = 0.35
  ),
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "%{text}",
    "<br>Minimum: %{x:.1f} °C",
    "<br>Maximum: %{y:.1f} °C",
    "<extra></extra>"
  )
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Daily minimum temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

A fixed random sample of up to 5,000 station-day observations
with both temperatures recorded is displayed.

### Monthly Distribution of Station Mean Maximum Temperatures {data-height=450}

```{r temperature-boxplot, echo=FALSE}
plot_ly(
  data = station_month_temp,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~mean_tmax,
  type = "box",
  boxpoints = FALSE,
  color = I("#3A9D78")
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Month",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = month.abb
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Monthly mean Tmax (°C)",
      automargin = TRUE
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

Each box summarizes station-year monthly mean daily maximum
temperatures for that calendar month. Only station-months with
at least 20 recorded daily maximum temperatures are included.
